text:
ryan: spotted a new ad from 'AtlasRun' claiming 'no tuning, universal latency' — want quick SDR lines + a 1-slide webinar note.

mona: paste link?

ryan: link pinned. claims: 'plug into any GPU, instant perf'.

gita: quick frame: call out tradeoffs — 'instant' != optimized for real traffic patterns (cache, batching, kernel choices matter).

sam: SDR one-liners (keep to one short sentence each):
- Tech: 'We tune runtime to your model and traffic for improved latency in production.'
- Exec: 'Predictable latency and transparent unit costs across hosted, dedicated, or private deployments.'

mona: legal prefers 'improved latency' phrasing — good.

gita: webinar bullets (short): 1) Serving-first runtime: kernels/batching/caching  2) Cost levers: batching + quantization guidance  3) Observability: token-level cost & latency breakdowns.

ryan: action items: @sam drop the two final 1-liners into Notion by 11:30 PT; @gita create a 1-slide frame by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Notion drop due 11:30 PT (channel: #marketing).

mona: thanks all — keep it punchy and SDR-friendly. :thumbsup:
